How Compound Interest Works

Compound interest is the interest earned on both your principal and any accrued interest. This means that your savings can grow exponentially over time, as the interest earned in previous periods is added to the principal and earns interest in subsequent periods. By understanding how compound interest works, you can make more informed decisions about your savings and investments.

A $1,000 investment earning 5% interest per year can grow to over $1,600 in just 10 years, thanks to the power of compound interest.

Action Step

Take the first step towards taking advantage of compound interest by opening a high-yield savings account or investing in a low-cost index fund. This will give you a head start on growing your savings and achieving your long-term financial goals.
